Like,Ⓒa.ⒹsadfSa (SI f.), tulya, sama; samAna, sanniBa, anukArin (with gen. or instr.); oft. by upama, niBa, rUpa, viDa, pratima, saMkASa, nIkASa, pratIkASa, BUta, (all in comp.); also by sa or anu in comp.; ‘of l(ike) properties’ saguRa, anuguRa-Darman, sama-tulya-guRa, samaBAva; ‘of l(ike) form’ sarUpa, anurUpa, tulyAkfti, tulyarUpa; ‘l(ike) a father’ pitfBUtaH, pitfsTAnIyaH; ‘of l(ike) class’ sajAti, sajAtIya, savarRa, savarga, tulyavarRa; ‘almost l(ike) Hara’ harakalpa; ‘l(ike) this’ IdfSa-S, etAdfSa-S; ‘l(ike) that’ tAdfS-Sa; ‘l(ike) what’ kIdfS-Sa; ‘l(ike) which’ yAdfS-Sa; ‘l(ike) me, -us’ mAdfSa, asmAdfSa, &c.; ‘l(ike) thee, you’ tvAdfSa, yuzmAdfSa, &c.; ‘l(ike) your honour’ BavAdfSa; ‘to be l(ike)’ anukf 8 U (with gen.), saMvad 1 P (with instr.), anuhf 1 P (with acc.); See Resemble; ‘the son was l(ike) his generating cause (father)’ na kAraRAt svAdviBide kumAraH (R. v. 57); ‘these and the l(ike)’ eva-mAdi; ‘in l(ike) manner’ taTA, evaM, tadvat, taTEva, evameva, evaMviDaM.
Ⓔs.ⒹsamaH, tulyaH, sadf-SaH, tulyaguRaH, yamakaH-laH; ‘his l(ike) was and will never be seen’ anena sadfSo na BUto na Bavizyati.
Ⓔadv.ⒹEx. by vat in comp., iva, yaTA, nirviSezaM in comp.; ‘l(ike) an earthen pot’ mfdGawavat; often by Karm. or Bah. comp.; ‘black l(ike) a cloud’ meGaSyAma; ‘having a moon-l(ike) face’ caMdra-muKa; ‘brought up l(ike) oneʼs own children’ apatyanirviSezaM saMvarDita; ‘to act l(ike)’ anukf.
Ⓑ
 2 Likely, q. v.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓruc 1 A (with dat. of person who likes); aBinaMd 1 P, anu-saM-aBi-man 4 A, anumud 1 A, praSaMs 1 P, prI pass., tuz 4 P; ‘does not l(ike) the present’ upAyanaM nABinaMdati, upAyanena na tuzyati &c., snih 4 P, anuraMj pass. (with loc.).
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓiz 6 P, aBilaz 1, 4 P, ruc; oft. by kAma in comp.; ‘just as you l(ike)’ yaste CaMdaH (

), yadBavate rocate; ‘doing as one l(ike)s’ kAmacAraH, svEravfttaH, svacCaMdaH, svErin; ‘taking what form he l(ike)s’ kAmarUpaH; ‘do what you l(ike)’ yaTABilazitaM kriyatAM.
Ⓝ[Lik]ed,Ⓒa.Ⓓmata, aBi-anu-saM-° izwa, priya, dayita.
Ⓝ[Lik]en,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓupa-mA 3 A, 2 P, sadfSIkf; See Compare.
Ⓝ[Lik]ing,Ⓒs.Ⓓruci f., aBiruciH, kAmaH, icCA, tozaH, prIti f., tuzwi f., praRayaH, anurAgaH, aBilAzaH, CaMdaH, CaMdas n., saM-anu-mati f.; ‘he was not to her l(ike)’ sa na tasyA rucaye baBUva (R. vi. 44); ‘of your l(ike)’ tvadaBimata.
Ⓝ[Like]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹsAdfSyaM, sAmyaM, tulyatvaM, AnurUpyaM, sArUpyaM, tulA, upamA, anukAraH, saMvAdaH, AnuguRyaM, OpamyaM, &c.
Ⓑ
 2 rUpaM, Akfti f., AkAraH, mUrti f.
Ⓑ
 3 pratimA-mAnaM, pratirUpaM-kftiH, pratimUrtiH, praticCaMdaH, citraM, AleKyaM, pratibiMbaM; ‘a speaking l(ikeness)’ saMvA-dinI AkftiH.
Ⓝ[Like]wise,Ⓒadv.ⒹtaTEva, taTA, tadvat.
Ⓑ
 2 api, api ca, kiM ca, taTA, aparaM ca.
ⓃLikely,Ⓒa.ⒹsaMBAvya, saMBavanIya, upapanna, satyasaMkASa; SradDeya; ‘it is l(ikely) that’ iti saMBavati or upapadyate.
Ⓑ
 2 (Probable) ex. by prAyaH, prAyaSaH, prAyeRa, with pot. pass. part., or by api nAma; ‘he is l(ikely) to come to-morrow’ prAyastena Sva AgaMtavyaM; api nAma tayoH aBimataH pARigrahaH syAt (

) ‘is it l(ikely) that &c.’
Ⓝ[Likeli]hood, [Likely]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹsaMBAvyatA saMBavaH; better by (a.); See above.
